_meta.purpose: Resolved 3D-solver ROS as a correction ratio to the Cheney regression, for the applet's hybrid mode.

blend.rule: w_emp = 1 below (threshold-width); linear ramp; 0 at or above threshold

_meta.stored: ratio = ROS_resolved / ROS_cheney_eq6, indexed by [U_10 m/s, ratio]; reconstruct as ratio x Cheney
_meta.wind_convention: U_10. The applet slider is U_2; convert with U_10 = U_2 / 0.723 before querying.
_meta.provenance: unitiedmodel2 local/diagnostics: cheney_phase19_sweep + phase20_blend_optB. ROS_Ts_m_min (level-set front tracker).
_meta.limits: Moisture sampled at 4% and 8% only; anything outside is extrapolation. Wind coverage is thin for Nat8/Cut4/Cut8 (two points each). The applet interpolates the solver's ANSWERS -- it does not run the solver.
